name: genpark-agentic-zero-knowledge-pii-token-vault-masker-skill
description: Enterprise Zero-Knowledge PII Tokenization Vault & Prompt Masker. Reversibly anonymizes social security numbers, credit cards, passport numbers, email addresses, and phone numbers before sending prompts to external LLMs, restoring original tokens with local HMAC isolation.

tools.name: mask_prompt_pii
tools.description: Reversibly mask PII tokens in prompt text and generate decryption restoration map.

raw_prompt.description: Prompt text containing potential sensitive PII.

mask_salt.description: Optional local secret salt for token hashing.

tools.name: unmask_completion_pii
tools.description: Restore synthetic pseudonyms in LLM completion response back to real user PII.

masked_completion.description: LLM output text containing synthetic PII tokens.

token_vault.description: Vault dictionary mapping synthetic tokens to real PII values.
